item.title: CultureFest — Thu Aug 20, 5:00 PM — Showalter Fountain
item.description:
Join us for CultureFest, Indiana University’s vibrant celebration of the many cultures, identities, and communities that make up our campus! This exciting event brings together students, faculty, and staff from all backgrounds to connect, explore, and celebrate the diversity that defines IU. Enjoy dynamic performances by student groups and individual artists representing a wide range of traditions, talents, and styles. Whether you're looking to discover something new or share in the familiar, there's something for everyone. Explore a variety of campus and community resources designed to support all students. Find your community, and engage with your peers. Come with curiosity, leave with connection.
Hosted by: First Year & Family Experience Programs
Additional Information can be found at: https://beinvolved.indiana.edu/event/12575468
Source: IU beINvolved Student Orgs, WFHB Community Calendar

Special Sneak Peek Screening of 'Timeless: Don Fischer's Half-Century Broadcasting IU Sports' — Thu Aug 27, 7:00 PM — SIMON SKJODT ASSEMBLY HALL
item.description:
For more than 50 years, Don Fischer's voice has provided the soundtrack to Indiana University athletics, narrating championships, buzzer-beaters, game-winning drives, and unforgettable Hoosier moments for generations of fans. On August 28, WTIU will premiere Timeless: Don Fischer's Half-Century Broadcasting IU Sports, a new documentary from Indiana Public Media celebrating one of the most recognizable voices in college sports broadcasting. Before the statewide television premiere, fans will have an opportunity to experience the film in one of the most iconic venues in Indiana University athletics. The event will give fans an opportunity to celebrate Don Fischer's remarkable career in the home of IU Basketball, where so many of the moments featured in the documentary first unfolded.
Source: IU Media School
